mapper.select:
SELECT t1.`access_type` AS `accessType`,
DATE_FORMAT(t1.`access_time`, '%Y-%m')
DATE_FORMAT(t1.`access_time`, '%Y-%m-%d')
DATE_FORMAT(t1.`access_time`, '%Y-%m-%d %H')
AS `bucket`, COUNT(*) AS `count` FROM `parking_access_record` t1
t1.`access_type` IN ('ACCESS_IN', 'ACCESS_OUT')
AND t1.`access_time` >= #{period.begin}
AND t1.`access_time` <= #{period.end}
AND t1.`parking_info_code` IN
#{parkingInfoCode}
GROUP BY t1.`access_type`, `bucket` ORDER BY `bucket`
